metric.description: Macro verified scaffold-hop rate@10, higher is better: each instance credits at most one all-gates-passing candidate per generic selected-core 2-core containment component among ranks1–10, divides the credited count by10, then averages over frozen instances. Missing ranks miss. Computational graph/pose verification is not experimental synthesis or affinity.
